description: Traffic Calming Database is a dataset listed in City of Toronto open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Toronto. The Vision Zero Project Unit within Transportation Services maintains a database that tracks existing locations with installed traffic calming measures. These measures are traffic islands, speed cushions and speed humps. The descriptions of these traffic calming measures can be found here. Coverage: Toronto. The portal files it under the publisher City of Toronto. Its tags are speed bumps. It offers 4 resource(s) in CSV, JSON, XML. The portal shows 2026-07-26 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-toronto-portal.
